southbank.name: South Bank Parklands
southbank.hours: Parklands open 24 hours · Streets Beach roughly 06:00–late, check on the day
southbank.tip: Bring a towel and swim at Streets Beach, the free man-made lagoon, then walk the riverside path at sunset.
southbank.best: Late afternoon into sunset; summer mornings to avoid heat

brisbane-river.name: Brisbane River
brisbane-river.price_text: Free to walk the banks · CityCat ferry fares extra
brisbane-river.hours: Riverside paths always open · ferry timetable check on the day
brisbane-river.tip: Ride a CityCat ferry up and down the river for a cheap sightseeing cruise, and hop off at South Bank or Howard Smith Wharves.
brisbane-river.best: Morning or golden hour; evening for lit-up bridges

uq.name: University of Queensland
uq.hours: Campus grounds generally open daily; buildings vary, check on the day
uq.tip: Walk the Great Court and the lakeside paths, and look for the UQ Art Museum if it is open.

citycat.name: CityCat ferry ride
citycat.price_text: ≈ AUD 3–6 per trip with a go card or contactless; check fares on the day
citycat.tip: Sit on the open back deck for the best views of the Story Bridge and Kangaroo Point cliffs.

storybridge.name: Story Bridge climb
storybridge.price_text: ≈ AUD 130–200 depending on time and day; book ahead
storybridge.hours: Daily, dawn to night climbs; check on the day
storybridge.tip: Book the twilight climb for city lights, and wear closed shoes as required.

kangaroopoint.name: Kangaroo Point Cliffs walk
kangaroopoint.tip: Walk the riverside path under the cliffs at sunset, then climb the stairs for a skyline view.

howardsmith.name: Howard Smith Wharves
howardsmith.price_text: Free to enter · food and drinks priced per venue
howardsmith.hours: Venues vary, roughly midday to late; check on the day
howardsmith.tip: Go for a drink under the Story Bridge at dusk, when the riverside bars fill up.

qagoma.name: Queensland Art Gallery and Gallery of Modern Art
qagoma.price_text: Free general entry · some exhibitions ticketed
qagoma.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00; check on the day
qagoma.tip: Free entry and air-conditioned, so it is a good rainy-day or hot-afternoon stop.

qmuseum.name: Queensland Museum
qmuseum.price_text: Free general entry · special exhibitions ticketed
qmuseum.hours: Daily roughly 09:30–17:00; check on the day
qmuseum.tip: The dinosaur and natural history galleries suit families; pair it with the art gallery next door.
qmuseum.best: Any time; good in rain or heat

westend-market.name: West End markets
westend-market.hours: Weekend markets, typically Saturday mornings; check on the day
westend-market.tip: Come early for fresh produce and breakfast, and bring cash for smaller stalls.

boundary-st.name: Boundary Street walk, West End
boundary-st.hours: Always open · cafes and shops vary
boundary-st.tip: Wander the side streets for cafes, bookshops and street art, then loop down to the river.

fortitude-valley.name: Fortitude Valley and James Street walk
fortitude-valley.tip: Do the walk by day for shops and cafes, and return at night for live music and bars.
fortitude-valley.best: Daytime for shopping, night for music

roma-st.name: Roma Street Parkland
roma-st.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk; check on the day
roma-st.tip: The subtropical gardens are quiet on weekday mornings and easy to reach from the CBD.

botanic.name: City Botanic Gardens
botanic.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk; check on the day
botanic.tip: Walk through the gardens to the river and continue along the Kangaroo Point path.

eagle-st.name: Eagle Street Pier and riverside dining
eagle-st.price_text: Free to walk · meals priced per venue
eagle-st.hours: Venues vary, roughly midday to late; check on the day
eagle-st.tip: Book a riverside table for dinner, or just walk the pier for free skyline views.

powerhouse.name: Powerhouse Museum
powerhouse.price_text: Free general entry · some events ticketed
powerhouse.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00; check on the day
powerhouse.tip: Check the program for free talks and family activities before you go.

lonepine.name: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary
lonepine.price_text: ≈ AUD 40–55 adult; check current prices and koala-hold extras
lonepine.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:00; check on the day
lonepine.tip: Go early for the koala talks, and check whether you need to book a ferry or bus from the city.

mtcoottha.name: Mount Coot-tha lookout
mtcoottha.hours: Lookout open daily, roughly dawn to late; check on the day
mtcoottha.tip: Come at sunset for city views, and check bus times if you are not driving.

eatstreet.name: Eat Street Northshore
eatstreet.price_text: Small entry fee, roughly AUD 3; food priced per stall
eatstreet.hours: Weekend evenings, typically Friday to Sunday; check on the day
eatstreet.tip: Arrive early to beat the queues, and bring cash for some stalls.

newfarm.name: New Farm Park and riverside walk
newfarm.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk; check on the day
newfarm.tip: Walk the river loop from the park to Howard Smith Wharves for a long, flat city walk.

queen-st.name: Queen Street Mall
queen-st.price_text: Free to walk · pay per shop
queen-st.hours: Shops roughly 09:00–17:30, later on Fridays; check on the day
queen-st.tip: Use it as a central meeting point and a rainy-day stop, with free live music some days.

xxxx.name: XXXX Brewery tour
xxxx.hours: Tours on set days and times; check on the day
xxxx.tip: Book online in advance and check the minimum age and closed-shoe rules.
